faqs.q: Sec. 30-14. - Compensation of judges of election.
faqs.a:
Judges of municipal elections for the city shall receive full compensation for their
               services, the monetary sum to be determined by the city clerk based generally upon
               the monetary sum paid by the Jefferson County Clerk for Jefferson County Election
               Judges.
(Code 1981, § 11-14; Ord. No. 3511, § 2, 2-1-1999)
